verdicts.quote: In committed join order, convert eligible entries to ordinary confirmed bookings and end their waiting entries until available capacity or the queue is exhausted.

verdicts.quote: It is appended in authoritative acceptance order. ... Waitlist-only holds with expiry, membership-based priority, reserved staff seats invented by this feature, and overbooking are out of scope. ... There is no staff queue editing, manual promotion

verdicts.where: Basis and scope; R-3 State and data
verdicts.quote: No changes to class discovery, guest or group booking, memberships, billing policy, or the existing cancellation policy are in scope. ... Existing billing/refund and cancellation terms take precedence.
verdicts.missing: Whether an automatic promotion that the member then late-cancels or no-shows counts against the existing no-show/late-cancellation policy is not stated.

verdicts.quote: An effective booking cancellation or authorized capacity increase that frees capacity on an open, enabled occurrence triggers allocation, including with no member online.
verdicts.missing: The trigger is stated but timeliness is explicitly unresolved ('numeric latency, retry and recovery targets ... are unresolved').

verdicts.quote: A separate waitlist provider, push subscription, incremental remote sync cursor, or new outbound notification service has no required consumer outcome. Confirmation is in the app and ordinary booking effects are preserved.

Multiple freed seats use the same order. ... Duplicate or delayed change signals re-evaluate current authority and cannot recreate a booking ... one confirmed booking at most per booking identity and occurrence, with no new booking above capacity.

verdicts.where: R-3.b; Non-functional booking integrity; R-1 State and data
verdicts.quote: Competing mutations resolve at the booking authority ... preserve one active entry and one confirmed booking at most per booking identity and occurrence ... A booked member has no active entry for the same occurrence

verdicts.missing: When payment is taken for a promoted booking and what happens if it fails are left as open gaps for the booking owner.

verdicts.quote: The largest supported queue, any admission cap and the runtime limits behind it are unresolved. If an evidenced cap applies, the next join is refused with a clear reason
verdicts.missing: Whether a cap exists and its value are undecided; the full-waitlist message is only 'a clear reason'.

verdicts.quote: End active entries when the occurrence is cancelled, deleted, materially rescheduled ..., or first reaches its ordinary booking close or start, whichever comes first. Entries end without bookings

authorized capacity increase that frees capacity ... triggers allocation ... If a capacity reduction wins, it removes that availability for further allocations. ... the waitlist cannot create or worsen over-capacity.
End active entries when the occurrence is cancelled ... Entries end without bookings and no longer carry priority. Explain closure on any still-accessible occurrence.

verdicts.quote: logical entry data consists of occurrence ID, booking identity, a distinct entry identity, committed order, status, the recorded opt-in ... Order is immutable for an entry.

verdicts.quote: Retain terminal information only for the applicable policy window and then remove it.

verdicts.where: R-6.c; R-5 State and data; R-6.b
